emails.subject: new location ops
emails.body:
Hi Sharon,

The 350-location ramp puts every opening team on the same clock.

Rivian faced a similar coordination layer across product and operations teams and built one connected view for the work moving between groups.

If this is relevant, open for a quick chat next week?

Luke

emails.subject: rollout tracking
emails.body:
Hi Sharon,

How are regional teams keeping each opening plan current once dates start moving?

The pattern peers flag is keeping owners, blockers, and next dates clear once field work moves faster than the weekly status readout.

Page link below if useful.

https://example.com/sharonp-chipotle

Luke

emails.subject: supplier coordination
emails.body:
Hi Sharon,

Supplier readiness becomes its own operating rhythm at this volume.

Sweetgreen handled a similar cross-functional handoff by giving procurement, ops, and finance one queue for what was blocked, owned, and ready.

Worth 20 minutes to compare notes?

https://example.com/sharonp-chipotle

Luke

emails.subject: field team scheduling
emails.body:
Hi Sharon,

Field scheduling gets harder once launch volume spikes.

The useful shift is a shared view of opening dates, readiness blockers, and team capacity, so the field calendar reflects the actual launch plan.

Leaving the page here as a reference.

emails.subject: opening readiness

emails.body:
